hooks.name: KiroGraph Deferred Sync
hooks.description: Sync the KiroGraph index when the agent stops and a dirty marker is present. Hardening notes: (1) runs from the repo root — hook cwd is not guaranteed, a bare `kirograph` in the wrong cwd answers 'not initialized'; (2) skips if another sync is already running — two overlapping syncs fight over kirograph.db.lock and a killed one leaves the lock behind, which silently broke the index for a week (every MCP call answered 'KiroGraph not initialized'); (3) clears such a stale, empty lock older than 30 min; (4) logs to .kirograph/hook.log instead of discarding stderr; (5) runs at low CPU priority — a sync costs ~3-4 min even with nothing to sync (full scan + global resolve of ~47k symbols) and ~20 min after ~130 changed files.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" || exit 0; pgrep -f 'kirograph [s]ync' >/dev/null && exit 0; find .kirograph -maxdepth 1 -type d -name kirograph.db.lock -mmin +30 -empty -delete 2>/dev/null; nice -n 15 kirograph sync-if-dirty --quiet >>.kirograph/hook.log 2>&1 || true
